FX-FRACTAL-001.says: The settings as they start: size 100, complexity 4, contrast 100, brightness 0, evolution 0, speed 0, seed 0, black to white, opacity 100, normal. The card is covered by grey clouds so large that the drawing sees a small part of one cell: close greys, near the middle. Every pixel keeps its covering, the empty ones stay empty, and with speed 0 frame 4 is frame 0.

FX-FRACTAL-002.says: Size 4: a cell of 2.7 pixels (D-756), so the greys vary across the card, lighter and darker patches.

FX-FRACTAL-003.says: Size 4, complexity 1.9, which counts as 1: one octave, the smooth value noise itself, softer than FX-FRACTAL-002's four.

FX-FRACTAL-004.says: Size 4, complexity 8: eight octaves, finer detail on top of FX-FRACTAL-002's.

FX-FRACTAL-005.says: Size 4, contrast 0: every shown pixel is the middle of the ramp, encoded exactly 0.5, at its own covering.

FX-FRACTAL-006.says: Size 4, contrast 300: FX-FRACTAL-002's greys three times as far from the middle, held at black and white.

FX-FRACTAL-007.says: Size 4, brightness 30: FX-FRACTAL-002's value lifted by 0.3, held at white.

FX-FRACTAL-008.says: Brightness -100: the value is held at 0 everywhere, so every shown pixel is black at its own covering.

FX-FRACTAL-009.says: Size 4, speed 90 degrees a frame: the clouds change from frame to frame; frame 0 is FX-FRACTAL-002, frame 2 is evolution 180, and frame 4 is evolution 360, FX-FRACTAL-010.

FX-FRACTAL-010.says: Size 4, evolution 360: one full turn moves the field one cell through its third direction, clouds of their own, not FX-FRACTAL-002's.

FX-FRACTAL-011.says: Size 4, evolution keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 720 at frame 4, linear, speed 0: frame 0 is FX-FRACTAL-002 and frame 2, at 360, is FX-FRACTAL-010.

FX-FRACTAL-012.says: Size 4, seed 7: clouds of their own.

FX-FRACTAL-013.says: Size 4, seed 7.9, which counts as 7: FX-FRACTAL-012.

FX-FRACTAL-014.says: Size 4, dark #1e1a24 and light #fff0b0: the clouds run from the dark violet to the cream, mixed in encoded values.

FX-FRACTAL-015.says: FX-FRACTAL-014 with its colours written in capitals: the same.

FX-FRACTAL-016.says: Size 4, blend multiply: the card darkened by the clouds, its own colours showing through; the black patch stays black.

FX-FRACTAL-017.says: Size 4, blend screen, opacity 50: the card lightened by the clouds, none darkened; the white patch stays white.

FX-FRACTAL-018.says: Size 4, blend add, opacity 50: the clouds added at half strength, not held, so the white patch goes past its covering.

FX-FRACTAL-019.says: Size 4, opacity keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 100 at frame 4, eased past its end (132.5 at frame 2): frame 0 is the drawing; frame 2 is held at 100 and is frame 4, FX-FRACTAL-002.

FX-FRACTAL-020.says: FX-FRACTAL-002 moved three pixels right: the clouds are worked in the drawing's own space, so they move with it.

FX-FRACTAL-021.says: Size 0, below 1. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-FRACTAL-022.says: Complexity 9, above 8. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-FRACTAL-023.says: Contrast 1001, above 1000. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-FRACTAL-024.says: Brightness -101, below -100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-FRACTAL-025.says: Seed -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-FRACTAL-026.says: Speed keyed to 400 at frame 4, above 360. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-FRACTAL-027.says: Blend "overlay", which is not a blend. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-FRACTAL-028.says: A dark colour written "#12345", one digit short. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
